### Types

The types the tables below name, from `account/domain.ts`:

```ts
type AccountStatus = "none" | "pending" | "active" | "suspended" | "deleted";

type AccountSuspensionReason = "owner_requested" | "abuse" | "by_platform";

type TokenPurpose = "verify" | "reset" | "email_change";

type SessionEnd = "signed_out" | "revoked" | "account_suspended" | "password_changed" | "account_deleted" | "reuse" | "idle" | "expired";
```

### Aggregates

| Aggregate | Unique keys | Facts |
|---|---|---|
| `account.account` | `link`, `email` | `active`, `mfa` |
| `account.session` | — | — |
| `account.sso` | `domain` (global) | — |

### Events

| Event | Fields | Vault | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AccountRegistered` | `email: string`<br>`name: string`<br>`passwordHash: string \| null`<br>`verified: boolean`<br>`at: number` | `email`, `name`, `passwordHash` under `the aggregate` | — |
| `VerificationRequested` | `tokenId: string`<br>`token: string \| null`<br>`email: string \| null`<br>`expiresAt: number` | `email` under `the aggregate`; `token` under `token:<tokenId>` | The token stays in the vault under its own subject until it is used. |
| `EmailVerified` | `tokenId: string` | erases `token:<tokenId>` | Erases the used token. |
| `SignedIn` | `sessionId: string`<br>`method: string`<br>`factors: string[]`<br>`refreshTokenHash: string`<br>`ip: string \| null`<br>`userAgent: string \| null`<br>`mfa: boolean`<br>`at: number` | `ip`, `userAgent` under `the aggregate` | — |
| `SignInFailed` | `method: string`<br>`reason: "wrong_password" \| "locked" \| "not_verified" \| "not_active" \| "not_linked"`<br>`ip: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `ip` under `the aggregate` | An event, not a rejection: audited, and it counts toward the lockout. |
| `SessionOpened` | `accountId: string`<br>`method: string`<br>`factors: string[]`<br>`refreshTokenHash: string`<br>`ip: string \| null`<br>`userAgent: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `ip`, `userAgent` under `the accountId` | — |
| `SessionRefreshed` | `generation: number`<br>`refreshTokenHash: string`<br>`ip: string \| null`<br>`accountId: string`<br>`factors: string[]`<br>`at: number` | `ip` under `the accountId` | — |
| `SessionFactorAdded` | `factor: string` | — | — |
| `SessionEnded` | `reason: SessionEnd` | — | — |
| `AccountSuspended` | `reason: AccountSuspensionReason`<br>`at: number` | — | Ends every session (a reactor); sign-in is refused. |
| `AccountReactivated` | — | — | — |
| `AccountDeleted` | — | erases `the aggregate` | Erases the account's personal data, in its events and its sessions'. |
| `PasswordChanged` | `hash: string`<br>`keepSessionId: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `hash` under `the aggregate` | Ends the account's other sessions (a reactor); `keepSessionId` is the one it was changed from. |
| `PasswordResetRequested` | `tokenId: string`<br>`token: string \| null`<br>`email: string \| null`<br>`expiresAt: number` | `email` under `the aggregate`; `token` under `token:<tokenId>` | The reset token sits in the vault under its own subject until used. |
| `PasswordReset` | `tokenId: string`<br>`hash: string`<br>`at: number` | `hash` under `the aggregate`; erases `token:<tokenId>` | Erases the used token; ends every session (a reactor). |
| `EmailChangeRequested` | `tokenId: string`<br>`token: string \| null`<br>`email: string \| null`<br>`expiresAt: number` | `email` under `the aggregate`; `token` under `token:<tokenId>` | The new address gets a token; it holds nothing until confirmed. |
| `EmailChanged` | `tokenId: string`<br>`email: string` | `email` under `the aggregate`; erases `token:<tokenId>` | Erases the used token; the account now holds the new address. |
| `RegistrationAttempted` | `email: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `email` under `the aggregate` | Someone registered with this account's address: it gets a mail saying it exists. |
| `TotpStarted` | `secret: string \| null` | `secret` under `the aggregate` | The TOTP secret the API generated and showed: personal, in the vault. Not in use until confirmed. |
| `TotpConfirmed` | `step: number`<br>`at: number` | — | TOTP is the account's second factor from now on (the first code's step: no code twice). |
| `TotpDisabled` | — | — | — |
| `RecoveryCodesGenerated` | `hashes: string[]` | — | The recovery codes' hashes; the codes were shown once. |
| `SecondFactorProved` | `sessionId: string`<br>`method: "totp" \| "recovery" \| "passkey"`<br>`step: number \| null`<br>`recoveryCodeHash: string \| null` | — | A session proved a second factor; a reactor adds it to the session. |
| `SecondFactorFailed` | `sessionId: string`<br>`at: number` | — | Counts toward the lockout, like a wrong password. |
| `PasskeyAdded` | `credentialId: string \| null`<br>`publicKey: string`<br>`counter: number`<br>`label: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `credentialId`, `label` under `the aggregate` | A passkey: its credential ID and label are personal; the public key (COSE, base64url) is not. |
| `PasskeyRemoved` | `credentialId: string \| null` | `credentialId` under `the aggregate` | — |
| `PasskeyUsed` | `credentialId: string \| null`<br>`counter: number` | `credentialId` under `the aggregate` | A passkey signed: its counter moves on (a cloned authenticator would fall behind). |
| `ProviderLinked` | `provider: string`<br>`subject: string \| null`<br>`email: string \| null`<br>`at: number` | `subject`, `email` under `the aggregate` | An external login (OAuth/OIDC, or a tenant's SSO as `sso:<id>`) linked to the account. |
| `ProviderUnlinked` | `provider: string`<br>`subject: string \| null` | `subject` under `the aggregate` | — |
| `SsoCreated` | `issuer: string`<br>`clientId: string`<br>`clientSecret: string \| null` | `clientSecret` under `sso:<id>` | The client secret is personal data of the configuration (`sso:<id>`), erased with it. |
| `SsoUpdated` | `issuer: string`<br>`clientId: string`<br>`clientSecret: string \| null` | `clientSecret` under `sso:<id>` | — |
| `SsoDomainAdded` | `domain: string`<br>`txt: string` | — | `txt`: the value the domain's DNS must carry at `_kernable-sso.<domain>`. |
| `SsoDomainVerified` | `domain: string` | — | — |
| `SsoDomainRemoved` | `domain: string` | — | — |
| `SsoEnforcementChanged` | `enforced: boolean` | — | Enforced: in this tenant, only sessions signed in through this SSO count (owners excepted). |
| `SsoDisabled` | — | — | — |
| `SsoEnabled` | — | — | — |
| `SsoDeleted` | — | erases `sso:<id>` | — |

### Queries

A query about one aggregate names it (`static target`): the middleware decides on that aggregate as on a command's.

| Query | Fields | About | Answer | Who may ask |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FindAccountByEmail`<br>by `account.accounts` | `email: string` | — | `{ id: string; status: AccountStatus }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetAccount`<br>by `account.accounts` | `accountId: string` | `account.account` in `accountId` | `AccountRow { id, email, name, status }` | the API (its `api` group), or the sender itself |
| `ListSessions`<br>by `account.accounts` | `accountId: string` | `account.account` in `accountId` | `SessionRow[]` | a group permission, or the sender itself |
| `FindAccountByLink`<br>by `account.accounts` | `provider: string`<br>`subject: string` | — | `{ id: string; status: AccountStatus }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `FindSsoByDomain`<br>by `account.ssos` | `domain: string` | — | `{ tenant: string; ssoId: string; issuer: string; clientId: string; enforced: boolean }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetSsoSecret`<br>by `account.ssos` | `ssoId: string` | — | `{ issuer: string; clientId: string; clientSecret: string \| null; domains: string[] }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetSso`<br>by `account.ssos` | `ssoId: string` | — | `Omit<SsoRow, "clientSecret">` | owners |
